Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of PFA NFR MLG payable at Maligaon . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Fixed Deposit Receipt made out or pledged in the name of A/C PFA NFR MLG . The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of EMD, the FDR will be released in the favour of the bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Bidder has to upload scanned copy/ proof of the FDR along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date/ Bid Opening date 5. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of PFA NFR MLG payable at Maligaon . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract.

6. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of PFA NFR MLG A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 7. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc. 8. Certificates To be eligible for award of contract, Bidder / OEM must possess following Certificates / Test Reports on the date of bid opening (to be uploaded with bid): 1. OEM Authorization certificate 2. Past performance 3. Handloom registration certificate . 10. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Handloom Mark Condition: a. Each Hand towel (turkish cotton, handloom) supplied should have the Han dloom Mark. b. The OEM should have Handloom Mark in his own name. In case of authorized dealer of O E M, Tender specific authorization letter from OEM to be attached along with the Bid. Firm s hould upload Ha ndloom Mark certification by Textile committee along with the Bid. c. Either OEM having Handloom Mark or their authorized dealer can submit the offer. Both OEM having Handloom Mark and their authorized dealer cannot bid simultaneously. In such cases both the offers will be considered ineligible and will be summarily rejected. d. OEM having Handloom Mark may note that either OEM or an agent can represent only o ne fir m in a tender and they cannot submit more than one offer against a tender through di fferent sole selling agents. In such a situation all the offers will be rejected. : e. The onus of submission of handloom mark reg istration certificate issued by textile com mittee along with offer shall lie with bidder. 2.2. Past Performance: The Manufacturer, Authorized Agent (Through their Principals) or Ape x Society sho uld have supplied same or similar item (similar means Hand towel (turkish cot ton, handloom) of same spe cification but different size/shade/colour) for 20% of bid quantit y in at least one of the last three financial y ears and current financial year till the bid openi ng date to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU. (a) For fulfilling the Past Performance criteria, any one of the following documents shall be c onsidered as valid proof for meeting the Past Performance criteria: (i) For GeM contracts, CRAC to be attached. (ii) Exec ution certificate by client with order value & quantity along with copy of the Purcha se/Supply Order. (iii) A ny other document in support of order execution like Third Party Inspection, Release n ote, R Notes etc.

along with copy of Purchase/Supply Order. (b) In case tenderers participate as an authorized agent, then t he performance as required above shall be that of the Principal, authorizing the agent. It may so happen th at the agent has credentials of past supply for a different Principal but this will not be considered as perf or mance for placing order in case of change of Principal. (c) The quantity of item supplied in the past though ACASH by a Handloom unit will also be considered as the supply performance of their Handloom unit. For c onsidering the supply p erformance through ACASH, the bidder should upload Supply Orders of ACASH on t hem alo ng with supply documents like R-Note, Inspection Certificate etc. (d) Firms without requisite perfor mance criteria or firms who have not attached documents , as mentioned above, in support of past perfor mance shall be ignored. Only firm with requi red performance, as mentioned in bid performance criteria, s hall be considered for placeme nt of order. 3. Sample Approval Clause-: After receipt of P.O. the firm should submit 03(Three) nos. sampl es within 10 days preferably from the issue of P.O. to the Dy.CMM/PNO for approval of gene ral appearance, lustre, feel, finish and shade of the Hand towel (turkish cotton, handloom) before bulk manufacturing. Dy.CMM/PNO, on approval, will keep one no. approved sample with him, and send one no. approved sample directly to insp ecting authority (RITES) for guidance during inspection and the remaining one a pproved sample shall be h anded over to the supplier. 4. Inspection: Pre-dispatch Inspection at Seller Premises: By RITES Post Receipt Inspection at consignee sit e before acceptance of stores: By CONSIGNEE It shall be mandated that testing of the material shall be co nducted, irrespective of the insp ection agency, at the NABL accredited lab before dispatch of material, an d not in the premi ses of manufacturer or supplier. 5. Settlement of Disputes: As per clause 2900 of Indian Railway Standard (IRS) Conditions o f Contract Sept ember 2022 Version 1.0 (or latest) 6. Required Documents: Firm must attach following documents along with any other document(s) required against t his bid 1. Documents in support of MSE registration (if applicable). 2. Documents as per Make in I ndia policy. 3. In case of authorized dealer, firm must attach bid specific authorization from OEM. 4. Docum ents in support of Past Performance. 5. Handloom Mark eligibility certificate 7. Bidders must submit EMD and exemption will be as per GeM GTC. .
